Music, my hobby

Sound recipes

Music is my hobby. These are recipes for one small rig, an OXI One MK2 sequencer, a Vermona PERfourMER MKII synth, an Electro-Harmonix Grand Canyon delay and a Strymon NightSky reverb, with every knob drawn where it should point.

  1. OXI One MK2sequencer
  2. PERfourMER MKIIsynth
  3. Grand Canyondelay
  4. NightSkyreverb

Recipes

  • 01

    The spiral of fifths

    Cosmic arpeggio from one note

    Play one note; it grows into a rising cascade of fifths that melts into a dark cloud. It sounds like a whole chord played by someone else.

  • 02

    Frozen sky

    Ambient pad you can play after it's frozen

    A slow chord that rises into a shimmering cathedral, then freezes in place. You turn one knob and the frozen sky moves up or down in semitones, like playing a second instrument.

  • 03

    Tape memory

    Lo-fi arpeggio, round-robin voices

    A fast arpeggio where every note is a different instrument, echoed by a worn tape machine and a grainy small room. Like a cassette of a song you half remember.

  • 04

    Backwards dream

    Reverse echoes, slow melody

    A slow melody whose echoes play in reverse, swelling into each note before it arrives, inside a reverb that builds slowly. Like a tape played backwards in a dream.

  • 05

    The singing reverb

    Drone plus a melody played by the reverb

    The synth holds one note. The reverb plays the melody: its built-in eight-step sequencer retunes the cloud in a pentatonic scale, gliding from note to note.

  • 06

    Three against four

    Polyrhythmic echo groove

    A bass in plain 4/4 and an echo that only knows threes. The two cycles cross and meet again every bar, and a simple blip becomes a groove.

The rig, wired once

Every recipe uses the same cables, so you wire it once and only turn knobs after that.

  • OXI One MIDI out→ PERfourMER MIDI INThe OXI plays the synth. Set each OXI sequencer's output port to ALL (or the TRS port your cable uses).
  • PERfourMER main OUTPUT L→ Grand Canyon INPUTEverything panned to the centre or left goes through the effects.
  • Grand Canyon L OUT and R OUT→ NightSky LEFT IN and RIGHT INStereo from the delay into the reverb.
  • NightSky rear switchINSTLINEThe manual says to use LINE with synthesizers: it adds 10 dB of clean headroom.
  • NightSky LEFT and RIGHT OUT→ your mixer or interfaceThe wet side of the rig.
  • PERfourMER channel 2 OUT→ your mixer, dryThe bass. Its own output skips the pedals.
  • PERfourMER channel 2 PANmaxFully right, so the bass stays out of the main left output that feeds the pedals. PAN doesn't affect a channel's own output, so the dry bass is untouched. Check once: with only channel 2 playing, the pedals should be silent.

Before every recipe: back to neutral

Recipes only list what matters for that sound, so start each one from here. It takes about two minutes.

  • PERfourMER EG INT and LFO INTnoonCentre on the oscillator and filter: no envelope or LFO movement until a recipe asks.
  • PERfourMER PLAYMODEM1M2P1P2D1D2Plain mono unless a recipe says otherwise.
  • PERfourMER channels 3 and 4 VOLUMEminOff unless a recipe uses them.
  • Grand Canyon secondary modeOffIf the delay type's LED is blinking on PITCH or DRUM, hold PING PONG about 2 s to switch back.
  • Grand Canyon top-left buttonsEXP MODE, MOMENT, TAILS and PING PONG all unlitThen press PING PONG only if a recipe asks.
  • Grand Canyon modeOnly the DELAY LED litPress the small white Mode button next to the DELAY and LOOPER LEDs until it is.
  • NightSkyINFINITE off, not in Sequence mode (ON LED not red)Hold INFINITE to leave Sequence mode.
  • NightSky voiceSHIMMER knob min, GLIMMER off, DRIVE offThe colour effects start off; a recipe turns on what it needs.
  • NightSky MOD DEPTHminNo modulation until a recipe asks.
  • NightSky DRYnoonUnity: the dry signal at its own level.

Levels, once

  1. Play a chord through the pedals with everything at neutral. If the Grand Canyon sounds crunchy on loud notes, turn the PERfourMER's MASTER VOLUME down: it sets the main output that feeds the pedals. Three voices playing together (P1 or M2 recipes) are louder than one.
  2. Set the bass level on your mixer so it sits under the wet side, not over it.

The bass: synth channel 2

Every recipe's sequencer 2 plays this patch on channel 2, unless the recipe gives its own.

  • WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTFull, warm once filtered.
  • OCTAVE16'Low.
  • CUTOFF10 o'clockRound, not buzzy.
  • RESONANCE9 o'clockA little body.
  • Filter EG INT1 o'clockA small punch at each note.
  • VCA MODEEGGATEONThe envelope shapes it.
  • ATTACKminInstant.
  • DECAYnoonMedium.
  • SUSTAIN1 o'clockHolds while the note is held.
  • RELEASE10 o'clockA short fade.
  • VOLUME2 o'clockThen set the level on your mixer.
  • PANmaxKeeps it out of the pedals (see the wiring above).

How to read a recipe

  • A knob drawing shows where to point the knob, as on a clock: 7 o'clock is fully left, noon is the middle, 5 o'clock is fully right. The blue arc is how far you've turned it.
  • A row of words is a button or switch: the dark one is the setting.
  • Each setting has one line of why under it. Read it once; after that, the drawings are enough.
  • Tap a row to tick it off as you set it; the ticks are saved in your browser. Hide the whys turns a recipe into a one-screen cheat card.
  • The Grand Canyon's two mini knobs are named in the table printed under them, for each delay type. Stepped positions are counted from fully left.
  • The positions are my starting points: tune them by ear. What each control does is checked against the manual, linked at the bottom of every recipe.

Set up the PERfourMER's MIDI channels (once)

  1. Press MIDI CH.
  2. Turn SELECT/SEQ to channel 1, then press the TRIG button of synth channel 1 (and of channels 3 and 4 when a recipe asks for them).
  3. Turn SELECT/SEQ to channel 2, then press the TRIG button of synth channel 2.
  4. Press MIDI CH again to leave.

On the OXI One: hold Shift and tap sequencer 1. On page 1 of its setup, set Ch to 1. Do the same for sequencer 2 with Ch 2. To pick a sequencer's mode (Mono, Poly…), turn knob 4 on that page and press it to confirm.
